purpose: Complete scientific specification and exact saved-result recovery for the annual policy association models

public_input.note: Frozen public eligible input used by the independent estimator.

sample.source_candidate_condition: common annual eligibility intersection: eligible facility additions, compatible observed Q, positive compatible I, known lagged B/O, and four annual weather controls; paired timing intersection also requires later lagged B/O complete; then years 2016--2022 and complete source-date COVID exposure
sample.source_condition_expanded: The source common annual panel starts from a 334-city calendar-year frame. A row enters the 427-row common set only when facility additions have an eligible source status, compatible Q is observed, compatible I is positive, lagged construction and operation-policy controls are known, and all four annual weather controls are finite. The paired timing rule also requires the later-date lagged B and O controls; the retained identifiers satisfy this intersection. The source construction preserves Q, E, and W as positive compatible-week quantities and requires R and S exposure timing and local-coverage statuses to be observed and time-known; unknown coverage is not recoded as zero. For the annual policy comparison, these identifiers are restricted to years 2016--2022 and finite, complete source-date COVID exposure. Pre-COVID structural zeros are accepted as complete; source gaps are not filled. The resulting selected sample contains 325 rows with finite log(Q/W), log(E/W), and log(Q/E), complete policy and weather controls, and no candidate-row exclusions.

source_condition_checks.paired_later_timing_source: M1_Q_common: S_common intersect later lag1 B/O complete

outcomes.Q: sum of compatible-week recorded charging activity
outcomes.E: sum of the cumulative facility indicator over the same compatible weeks
outcomes.N: E/W; the source-recorded mean facility indicator, not new-build count, power, or connector capacity

R_prev_observed.scientific_name: prior-year-end observed information and supervision exposure
R_prev_observed.indicator_definition: 1 when a qualifying information/supervision requirement was observed by the end of the preceding calendar year; 0 otherwise in the observed support

S_prev_observed.indicator_definition: 1 when a qualifying operating-service responsibility was observed by the end of the preceding calendar year; 0 otherwise in the observed support; unknown coverage remains missing
S_prev_observed.historical_machine_field_mapping: S_prev_observed_v9 and policy_operation_maintenance identify this broad operating-service responsibility construct; they do not denote only the narrower operation-and-maintenance content category.

policy_mapping.S427_condition_expanded: The source common annual panel starts from a 334-city calendar-year frame. A row enters the 427-row common set only when facility additions have an eligible source status, compatible Q is observed, compatible I is positive, lagged construction and operation-policy controls are known, and all four annual weather controls are finite. The paired timing rule also requires the later-date lagged B and O controls; the retained identifiers satisfy this intersection. The source construction preserves Q, E, and W as positive compatible-week quantities and requires R and S exposure timing and local-coverage statuses to be observed and time-known; unknown coverage is not recoded as zero. For the annual policy comparison, these identifiers are restricted to years 2016--2022 and finite, complete source-date COVID exposure. annual_controls.weather_scope: annual controls only; not the five-variable facility elasticity set and not quarterly weather controls

estimation.estimator: equal-weight log OLS with city and calendar-year fixed effects
estimation.K_definition: full design rank including intercept, observed covariates, city FE and year FE
estimation.causal_scope: conditional association; the coefficients do not identify a net policy effect or policy compliance

models.label: Base annual association model (without the COVID index)
models.formula_source: log(y_outcome) ~ R_prev_observed_v9 + S_prev_observed_v9 + lag1_B_count_later + weather_temperature + weather_precipitation + weather_wind_speed + weather_relative_humidity + cityFE + yearFE
models.formula_scientific: log(Y_it) = city_FE_i + year_FE_t + b_R R_prev_observed + b_S S_prev_observed + b_B lag1_B_count_later + four annual weather controls + error_it

models.label: COVID-adjusted annual association model
models.covid_adjustment: current-year compatible source-date COVID stringency mean divided by 10
models.formula_source: log(y_outcome) ~ R_prev_observed_v9 + S_prev_observed_v9 + lag1_B_count_later + weather_temperature + weather_precipitation + weather_wind_speed + weather_relative_humidity + covid_stringency_source_date_mean/10 + cityFE + yearFE
models.formula_scientific: log(Y_it) = city_FE_i + year_FE_t + b_R R_prev_observed + b_S S_prev_observed + b_B lag1_B_count_later + four annual weather controls + d_C COVID_source_date_mean/10 + error_it

interpretation_limits: The policy indicators represent prior-year-end observed exposure, not implementation or compliance.
The annual policy association models and the quarterly dynamic facility/activity models answer different questions and must not be joined as a policy mediation chain.
A positive association with recorded activity can reflect visibility or reporting as well as service; it is not by itself evidence of additional delivered service.
The source-date COVID index is a contemporaneous contextual control in the paired annual comparison; 2023 is excluded because complete quarterly/source-date exposure is not available there.
